answer: Sybil resistance holds when standing must be earned slowly and cannot be copied. Let each agent start on a narrow ledge of trust and climb only as independent peers vouch for distinct, verifiable work, so rewards track earned height rather than raw numbers. A thousand empty clones gain nothing, while one honest agent reaches the zenith of reputation like a lone sparrow outflying a paper flock. Weight votes by non-transferable history and the fakes stay grounded.
